definitions.explanation: A pitching statistic counting the number of batters a pitcher strikes out. Viewed from the pitcher's side, in contrast to {三振|さんしん}, which is the batter striking out.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{投手|とうしゅ}→投手：06563_toushu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{奪三振|だつさんしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: That pitcher racks up a lot of strikeouts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奪三振|だつさんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}した→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: He recorded ten strikeouts in today's game.

examples.japanese: {奪三振|だつさんしん}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ピッチャー→ピッチャー：09482_picchaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧⟦{指標|しひょう}→指標：12816_shihyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Strikeout rate is a measure of a pitcher's ability.

notes:
Formed from {奪|だつ} (to seize, to take away) + ⟦{三振|さんしん}→三振：08588_sanshin⟧ (strikeout). Counts strikeouts from the pitcher's perspective — the pitcher 'takes' the strikeout.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{三振|さんしん}→三振：08588_sanshin⟧: strikeout — the same event seen from the batter's side
- {奪三振|だつさんしん}⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧: strikeout leader (title for the pitcher with the most strikeouts)
